lines.trans: Word is out that CEO Byun started another generational shift—will 2 Days & 1 Night end up overhauling its cast too?
With the preemption you finally got a few days off—what kept you at the station this late?
I stayed to watch the preview screening of that replacement pilot, Star Wars.
Oh, the one airing in your timeslot? How does it look?
Honestly, it was good—punchy and fresh!
Oh dear… does that make you feel pretty uneasy?
Our show runs on an old format and ratings are struggling right now, so having something fierce and fresh air in our slot naturally makes me uneasy.
You should have persuaded Senior Tae-ho or Director Jang somehow and blocked the preemption in the first place!
Yeah, you are right—because a preemption is someone else's golden opportunity and a crisis for me.
Oh come on, do not look so grim! Is that pilot really that funny—a total smash hit?

그러다.gloss: to say so; to do so
